description: Sample Company Salesforce cold calling scripts

tokens.{PROOF_POINT}: One client cut support ticket volume by 40% in 8 weeks

aiPressure.name: AI Pressure Question (Recommended)
aiPressure.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. I'll be honest — this is a cold call, so I'll be quick. Are you seeing pressure to do more with AI in your Salesforce environment, or is that not really on your radar yet?"
aiPressure.why: Opens with THEIR situation. Acknowledges the interruption. The question is easy to answer and gets them talking.

supportCost.name: Support Cost Question
supportCost.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. Quick question — is reducing customer support costs something that's on your priority list this year, or is that not where the pressure is right now?"
supportCost.why: Goes straight to a pain point. If they say yes, you have an opening. If they say no, you can pivot to sales performance.

salesPerformance.name: Sales Performance Question
salesPerformance.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. I'm curious — are you getting everything you need out of Salesforce right now, or is there a gap between what it could do for your sales team and what it's actually doing?"
salesPerformance.why: Invites them to share frustrations. Most Salesforce users feel they're not getting full value.

permissionHybrid.name: Permission + Problem Hybrid
permissionHybrid.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. I'll be honest — this is a cold call, so I'll be quick. A lot of companies we talk to are sitting on AI features in Salesforce they're not using yet — stuff that could genuinely cut support costs or speed up their sales cycle. Is that something you'd want to explore, or is this a bad time?"
permissionHybrid.why: Acknowledges the cold call, hints at value, gives them an easy out (which paradoxically makes them more likely to engage).

primary.name: Primary Value Pivot
primary.script: "So here's why I called you specifically. Sample Company is Australia's most cost-effective Salesforce implementation partner — we're 300 people with a hybrid onshore-offshore model that delivers implementations at 30-40% less than traditional consultancies. But what's really relevant right now is that Salesforce just released Agentforce — AI agents that can handle customer inquiries autonomously. One of our clients cut their support ticket volume by 40% in 8 weeks. Is that the kind of thing that would be useful to explore?"
primary.when: After they show interest or acknowledge the problem

aiInterest.name: AI Interest Pivot
aiInterest.script: "Perfect — that's exactly why I'm reaching out. Salesforce has released some genuinely useful AI this year — Agentforce for autonomous customer service, Einstein Copilot for sales reps, automated workflows that actually work. Most companies haven't dug into it yet because, frankly, their existing partners haven't either. We're different — we're 300 people focused only on Salesforce, and we're Australia's most cost-effective implementation partner. Our hybrid model means you get Australian project leadership with global development capacity at 30-40% lower cost. Would it be useful to see what's actually possible with these new tools?"
aiInterest.when: When they express interest in AI

costPressure.name: Cost Pressure Pivot
costPressure.script: "That's exactly what we help with. Sample Company is Australia's most cost-effective Salesforce implementation partner — our hybrid onshore-offshore model delivers implementations at 30-40% less than Big Four consultancies. Same quality, smarter delivery model. And the new Salesforce AI features — Agentforce, Einstein — can dramatically reduce support costs in months, not years. We helped one client cut support ticket volume by 40% in 8 weeks. Would it be worth exploring what's possible for your situation?"

salesGaps.name: Sales Gaps Pivot
salesGaps.script: "You're not alone — most companies feel that way about Salesforce. Here's the thing: Salesforce's new AI tools — Einstein Copilot for reps, AI-powered forecasting, automated lead scoring — can genuinely close that gap. We're Sample Company, Australia's most cost-effective Salesforce partner. Our hybrid model means you get enterprise-quality implementations at 30-40% less than traditional consultancies. We've helped companies improve deal velocity and win rates using these new tools. Would it be useful to see what might work for your team?"
salesGaps.when: When they mention Salesforce isn't delivering full value

ceoMeeting.name: CEO Meeting Close
ceoMeeting.script: "Here's what I'd suggest. I'd love to set up a 20-minute call with our CEO — no pitch, just a conversation. He'll walk you through the latest Salesforce AI innovations, what we're seeing work in companies like yours, and whether any of it makes sense for your plans. If it's not relevant, you'll know in 20 minutes. Would [specific day] at [specific time] work?"
ceoMeeting.when: When prospect is engaged and interested

aiDeck.name: AI Deck Offer
aiDeck.script: "I get it — timing isn't always right for a call. Tell you what: we've put together a really practical deck on how to implement AI in Salesforce with real business impact — not theory, actual use cases and results. Would it be useful if I sent that over? It's a good way to see if our approach resonates, and if it does, we can talk further when the timing makes sense."
aiDeck.when: When prospect is interested but not ready for meeting

deckAccepted.name: Deck Accepted Response
deckAccepted.script: "Great — I'll send it over today. It covers how companies are using Agentforce and Einstein to drive real results, plus some specific examples of cost reduction and sales improvement. Take a look when you have a chance, and I'll follow up in a week or so to see if it sparked any questions. If it's useful, we can set up time with our CEO to go deeper. Sound good?"
deckAccepted.when: After they agree to receive the deck

hybrid.name: Hybrid Close
hybrid.script: "Here's an idea: let me send you our AI implementation deck — it's practical, not salesy, and shows how companies are getting real results from Salesforce AI. Take a look, and if it resonates, I'll connect you with our CEO for a 20-minute conversation to go deeper. That way you can see our thinking first before committing any time. Fair?"
hybrid.when: When you want to give them an easy on-ramp

existingPartner.trigger: We already have a Salesforce partner
existingPartner.response: "Makes sense — most companies do. Quick question: are they bringing you insights on the new AI capabilities, or is that not really their focus? [If not] We've put together a deck on implementing AI in Salesforce with real business impact — practical, not theoretical. Might be a useful benchmark even if you stay with your current partner. Worth sending over?"

notLooking.trigger: We're not looking for new vendors
notLooking.response: "Completely fair — I'm not asking you to switch anything today. What I can offer is our AI implementation deck — it shows how companies are getting real results from Salesforce AI. Good for staying current even if you're not making changes. Can I send it over so you have it when the time is right?"

sendEmail.response: "Happy to. I'll include our AI implementation deck — it's the most useful thing I can share. It covers how to implement Salesforce AI with real business impact. Take a look, and if it resonates, we can talk further. What email should I use?"

handleInHouse.response: "That's great — strong internal teams are valuable. We've put together a deck on AI implementation in Salesforce that might be useful for your team — practical frameworks and real results, not vendor marketing. Could save them some research time. Worth sending over?"

notReadyForAI.trigger: We're not ready for AI yet
notReadyForAI.response: "Honestly, that's what most companies say — and it's fair. What's changed is that Salesforce has made AI much more accessible. We've put together a deck that shows what's actually possible now and how to implement it with real impact. Good for planning even if you're not ready to move yet. Can I send it over?"

whatMakesDifferent.response: "Three things. First, we're Australia's most cost-effective Salesforce implementation partner — our hybrid onshore-offshore model means Australian project leadership with global development capacity at 30-40% lower cost. Second, we're 300 people focused only on Salesforce — not a generalist consultancy. Third, we're genuinely current on AI implementation — we've put together a deck on how to do it with real business impact. Want me to send it so you can see our thinking?"

offshoreConcerns.response: "That's a fair concern — and exactly why we built a hybrid model. Your project leads and architects are onshore, right here in Australia. The offshore team handles development under their direct supervision. You get local accountability with the cost benefits of a global team. It's how we deliver enterprise quality at 30-40% lower cost. Want to see how it works in practice?"

happyWithSetup.trigger: We're happy with our current setup
happyWithSetup.response: "Glad to hear it. Quick question: are you using any of the new AI features — Agentforce, Einstein Copilot? Those are where we're seeing the biggest impact. We have a deck on implementing AI in Salesforce that might be useful even if you're not making changes — good for staying current. Worth sending over?"

callBackLater.response: "Totally fair. Let me send you our AI implementation deck in the meantime — it's practical and worth a look when you have 10 minutes. I'll follow up in a couple weeks to see if it sparked any questions. If the timing's better then, we can set up a proper conversation. Sound good?"

tooExpensive.response: "I understand budget is critical. Here's the thing — our hybrid model means we deliver at 30-40% less than traditional consultancies. And the AI features we implement typically show ROI in months, not years. One client cut support ticket volume by 40% in 8 weeks. Would it help to see a business case from a similar company?"

call.name: Follow-up Call Script
call.script: "Hi [NAME], it's [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. I sent over our AI implementation deck last week — did you get a chance to look at it? [If yes] What stood out to you? [If no] No worries — I know things get busy. The key takeaway is how companies are using Agentforce to cut support costs and Einstein to improve sales performance — real results, not just theory. Would it be worth a quick call with our CEO to explore whether any of that applies to your situation?"

email.subject: Quick question about the AI deck
email.body:
Hi [NAME],

I sent over our Salesforce AI implementation deck last week. Curious if anything resonated — particularly the sections on [support cost reduction / sales performance improvement].

If it's useful, I'd love to connect you with our CEO for a 20-minute conversation to go deeper. If the timing's not right, no worries — just let me know and I'll check back in a few months.

— [YOUR_NAME]

keyMessages: Sample Company — 300-person Salesforce specialist based in Sydney
Australia's most cost-effective Salesforce implementation partner
Hybrid onshore-offshore — Australian leadership, global development capacity, 30-40% lower cost
Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, automated workflows — stuff that actually works now
One client cut support ticket volume by 40% in 8 weeks
Our AI implementation deck — practical, not theoretical, shows how to get real results
20-minute call with our CEO — no pitch, just a conversation

crmPain.name: CRM Pain Question (Recommended)
crmPain.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. I'll be quick — I'm calling because we help Australian companies get better visibility into their sales pipeline and customer relationships. Quick question: are you happy with how you're currently tracking customer interactions and sales opportunities, or is that an area where you're looking to improve?"
crmPain.why: Opens with business value, not product. Gets them talking about their current situation without assuming any tool.

growthChallenge.name: Growth Challenge Question
growthChallenge.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. Quick question for you — as your business has grown, has keeping track of customer relationships and sales opportunities become harder, or do you have that pretty well sorted?"
growthChallenge.why: Connects to a universal growth pain point. Works whether they use spreadsheets, basic tools, or nothing at all.

techStack.name: Tech Stack Curiosity
techStack.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. We're a Salesforce implementation partner, and I'm curious — what are you using to manage customer relationships and sales tracking today? Spreadsheets, another CRM, or something else?"
techStack.why: Direct and honest. Gets intel on their current setup immediately so you can tailor the conversation.

aiOpportunity.name: AI Opportunity Question
aiOpportunity.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. I'll be honest — this is a cold call, so I'll keep it short. We're seeing a lot of companies looking at AI to automate customer service and boost sales productivity. Is that something on your radar, or is that not where your priorities are right now?"
aiOpportunity.why: Leads with AI value prop which is relevant regardless of current CRM. Opens door to discuss Salesforce as the AI-ready platform.

competitorPain.name: Current System Frustration
competitorPain.script: "Hi [NAME], this is [YOUR_NAME] from Sample Company. We specialise in helping companies move to Salesforce from other systems — or from spreadsheets and manual processes. Quick question: are you getting everything you need from your current setup, or are there gaps that are starting to slow the business down?"
competitorPain.why: Positions migration expertise upfront. Invites them to share frustrations with their current approach.

fromSpreadsheets.name: From Spreadsheets
fromSpreadsheets.script: "I hear that a lot — spreadsheets work until they don't. The challenge is when you need to see your full pipeline at a glance, or when multiple people need to update the same data, or when a key person leaves and takes all the relationship knowledge with them. That's exactly when companies look at Salesforce. The good news is, Salesforce has gotten much more accessible, and with Sample Company's hybrid model, we can implement it at 30-40% less than the big consultancies. Would it be worth a quick conversation to see what's actually involved?"

fromHubSpot.name: From HubSpot
fromHubSpot.script: "HubSpot's a good starting point, but a lot of companies outgrow it — especially around reporting, workflow automation, and now AI. Salesforce's new AI features like Agentforce and Einstein are genuinely game-changing, and HubSpot isn't anywhere close. The other thing is scale — Salesforce handles enterprise complexity that HubSpot struggles with. We've helped several companies migrate from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the ROI is usually clear within months. Want to hear what that looks like?"

fromDynamics.name: From Dynamics
fromDynamics.script: "Dynamics works for some companies, but what we often hear is that it's clunky, the Salesforce integrations are better, and the AI features aren't as mature. Salesforce has really pulled ahead on the AI side — Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, automated workflows. And as a pure-play Salesforce partner, we can implement faster and at lower cost than the Microsoft consultancies. Would it be worth exploring what a migration could look like?"

fromLegacy.name: From Legacy System
fromLegacy.script: "Legacy systems are tough — they work until you need them to do something new. The challenge is they can't adapt to things like AI, modern integrations, or mobile access. A lot of companies are facing this right now. Salesforce is designed to evolve with you, and with the new AI capabilities, you're not just fixing today's problems — you're setting up for the next 10 years. We specialise in helping companies migrate from legacy systems. Would a conversation about what's involved be useful?"

fromNothing.name: From No System
fromNothing.script: "Honestly, that's where a lot of growing companies are. You get by with spreadsheets and email until suddenly you can't — deals fall through, customer history is scattered, and growth actually becomes harder. The smart move is getting on a proper platform before it becomes urgent. Salesforce is the market leader for good reason, and with Sample Company's hybrid model, it's more affordable than most people think. Would it be useful to see what's actually involved in getting started?"

aiAngle.name: AI Angle
aiAngle.script: "Here's what's changed: AI is no longer future stuff — it's working right now. Salesforce's Agentforce can handle customer inquiries 24/7, Einstein Copilot helps sales reps work faster, and automated workflows can replace hours of manual work. But you need a platform that supports it. Salesforce is purpose-built for AI in a way that other CRMs and definitely spreadsheets aren't. And with Sample Company, you get Salesforce implementation at 30-40% less than traditional consultancies. Would it be worth exploring what AI could do for your business?"

weUseHubSpot.trigger: We use HubSpot and it works fine
weUseHubSpot.response: "That's fair — HubSpot is solid for getting started. The question is: are you bumping into its limits yet? Things like complex reporting, workflow automation, or scaling with your growth? And the big one now is AI — Salesforce's Agentforce and Einstein are way ahead of anything HubSpot offers. We've helped companies migrate when they hit that ceiling. Would it be useful to understand what the upgrade path looks like, even if you're not ready now?"

weUseDynamics.response: "Makes sense — it's a common choice, especially for Microsoft shops. What we often hear is that the CRM side of Dynamics is clunky compared to Salesforce, and the ecosystem isn't as rich. Plus Salesforce is genuinely ahead on AI right now. We've done several Dynamics to Salesforce migrations, and the feedback is usually 'wish we'd done this sooner.' Would it be worth a conversation about what's involved?"

justSpreadsheets.response: "Honestly, a lot of companies do — and it works until it doesn't. The tipping point is usually when you can't see your full pipeline, when deals slip through the cracks, or when someone leaves and takes all the relationship knowledge with them. The good news is Salesforce is more accessible than people think, especially with Sample Company's 30-40% lower cost model. Would it be useful to see what getting started actually looks like?"

crmOverkill.trigger: CRM seems like overkill for us
crmOverkill.response: "I hear that a lot. Here's the thing though — the companies that grow successfully usually have their customer data sorted before they need it urgently. Salesforce can start lean and scale with you. And with the new AI features, you're not just getting a database — you're getting automation that saves real time. Would a quick conversation about what makes sense for your situation be useful?"

triedCRMBefore.trigger: We tried CRM before and it didn't stick
triedCRMBefore.response: "That's really common, actually — and usually it's not the tool, it's the implementation. Either it wasn't set up for how your team actually works, or there wasn't proper training and adoption support. That's exactly what we focus on at Sample Company. We don't just implement and leave — we make sure it actually gets used. Would it be worth hearing how we approach that differently?"

salesforceTooExpensive.response: "That's what a lot of people think — and it used to be more true. Two things have changed: first, Salesforce has more flexible pricing now, including Starter editions. Second, Sample Company's hybrid model means implementation costs are 30-40% lower than traditional consultancies. When you factor in the productivity gains and the AI capabilities, the ROI is usually clear within 6-12 months. Would it be useful to see what it might actually cost for your situation?"

noBandwidth.trigger: We don't have the bandwidth to implement a CRM
noBandwidth.response: "That's exactly why our model works. Sample Company handles the heavy lifting — we configure it for how your team works, migrate your data, and train your people. Your team's involvement is minimal. And because of our hybrid model, it costs less than you might expect. Would it be worth a conversation about what a realistic timeline and commitment looks like?"

industryDifferent.trigger: Our industry is different / We have specific needs
industryDifferent.response: "That's actually where Salesforce shines — it's incredibly customisable. We've implemented it across healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, you name it. Whatever your specific workflows are, we can build them in. And the AI features work across industries. What's unique about your business that you think might be challenging?"

waitingOnAI.trigger: We're waiting to see how AI develops
waitingOnAI.response: "Fair enough — but here's the thing: AI is working right now, not future tense. Salesforce's Agentforce is handling customer inquiries autonomously today. Companies are cutting support costs by 40%+ in weeks. Waiting means your competitors might get there first. Would it be worth at least understanding what's possible now, so you can make an informed decision about timing?"

salesforceHardToUse.trigger: We've heard Salesforce is hard to use
salesforceHardToUse.response: "That used to be more true, but the interface has improved a lot. More importantly, that's where implementation matters. A well-configured Salesforce that matches how your team actually works is intuitive. A poorly implemented one is painful. That's why we focus so much on understanding your processes before we build anything. Would it help to see a demo of how it actually looks when it's done right?"

discovery.name: Discovery Close
discovery.script: "Here's what I'd suggest. Let's set up a 30-minute discovery call — no pitch, just a conversation about your business, how you're managing customer relationships today, and where you want to be. If Salesforce makes sense, we can talk about what that looks like. If it doesn't, I'll tell you. Would [specific day] at [specific time] work?"

demo.name: Demo Close
demo.script: "What I'd suggest is a quick demo tailored to your industry. I can show you how companies like yours use Salesforce — not the generic version, but what it actually looks like for [their vertical]. Takes about 30 minutes. That way you can see if it resonates before committing any serious time. Would that be useful?"

roiConversation.name: ROI Conversation Close
roiConversation.script: "Here's an idea. Before we talk features, let me put together a quick ROI analysis for your situation — based on your team size, your industry, and what you're trying to achieve. That way you can see actual numbers before deciding if it's worth exploring further. Would that be helpful?"

competitorComparison.name: Competitor Comparison Close
competitorComparison.script: "I know you're using [competitor/current system]. What I'd suggest is a side-by-side comparison — not marketing material, but an honest look at where Salesforce is stronger and where it might not matter for your situation. That way you can make an informed decision. Would that be useful to see?"
